turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes, so start with who decided that, and when.
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. That's your own procedure, 4.2, and I'm writing down that you said it. Now what is this zero actually based on?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
Withdrawn today, nothing on his record, in writing tonight. I'm writing all of that down. If the zero is gone, Hale, on what basis is my son rewriting anything?
Here it is in writing, signed.
Okay. I'm keeping this copy. Who else has seen this zero, and is there anything sitting on his file right now?
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.

I'm not done, Hale. You haven't told me who else has seen this zero or whether anything is on his file right now. And I still want to know why my son is rewriting an essay you've just withdrawn the zero on.
Then I'm going to the principal's office next, with your signed page in my hand. Who has seen it, what's on his file, and why the rewrite.
